items.title: Democrats Launch Nvidia Investigation Over Alleged 'Scheme' with Trump
items.summary: Democrats have initiated an investigation into Nvidia, sending a scathing letter to CEO Jensen Huang regarding an alleged scheme involving the company and former President Trump.

items.title: Google Search Gets Major Upgrade with Gemini 4 Hydrogen Integration
items.summary: Google Search has received a significant enhancement through the integration of Gemini 4 Hydrogen, promising advanced AI capabilities for search queries.

items.title: The Unfolding Jensen Huang Scandal: A Detailed Timeline
items.summary: A comprehensive timeline details the unfolding scandal surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, highlighting its potential implications for the tech industry.

items.title: Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks
items.summary: New research explores methods for scaling the supervision of mathematical proofs by leveraging structured textbook data, aiming to improve AI's reasoning capabilities.

items.title: Incentivizing Self-Learning in Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: A new paper proposes using reinforcement learning to incentivize self-learning behaviors in large language models, potentially leading to more autonomous and capable AI.

items.title: Your MCP Servers Are Silently Draining Your Context Window: The Hidden Cost of Tool-Heavy AI Agents
items.summary: An article highlights how tool-heavy AI agents can inadvertently consume significant context window resources, leading to performance issues and hidden costs for MCP servers.

items.title: Muse Now Offers Paid Calling to US Businesses
items.summary: The AI assistant Muse has expanded its capabilities to include placing calls to U.S. businesses, a feature now available to paying subscribers.

items.title: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
items.summary: Researchers introduce a new benchmark to evaluate generalist tabular models across diverse tasks including data generation, imputation, and prediction, providing a comprehensive assessment of their capabilities.

items.title: SteerDistill: Quantizing LLM Agents via Closed-Loop Teacher Steering
items.summary: A new technique called SteerDistill is proposed for quantizing LLM agents, utilizing closed-loop teacher steering to maintain performance while reducing model size.

items.title: MACaQ: Fast, Model Agnostic Calibrated Quantization for Low-Precision Weights and Activations
items.summary: MACaQ presents a fast and model-agnostic calibrated quantization method designed for low-precision weights and activations, enhancing efficiency in AI models.

items.title: BirdDreams: Joint Perspective and BEV Video Generation for a Plausible, Reactive Driving World Model
items.summary: BirdDreams introduces a novel approach for generating videos from both bird's-eye view (BEV) and first-person perspectives, creating a plausible and reactive world model for autonomous driving simulations.

items.title: VS Code Extension Transforms Any Free Chatbot Website into an AI Agent
items.summary: A new VS Code extension allows users to convert virtually any free chatbot website into a functional AI agent, offering a novel way to leverage existing conversational AI tools.

items.title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
items.summary: Research reveals the unexpected effectiveness of strategically deleting weights in large language models after initial training, leading to potential efficiency gains without significant performance loss.

items.title: Duo: A Reciprocal World Model for Full-Duplex Interaction
items.summary: Duo introduces a reciprocal world model designed to enable full-duplex interaction in AI systems, allowing for more natural and continuous communication.

items.title: Read Less, Solve More: Token-Efficient Sparse Reading of External Content for AI Agents
items.summary: A new paper proposes a token-efficient sparse reading mechanism for AI agents to process external content, enabling them to solve tasks more effectively with fewer computational resources.
